name: blog-workspace
description: Sajilo Blog - Full Stack Application Workspace

scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix sajilo-blog"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix sajilo-blog"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix sajilo-blog && npm run check:server
scripts.check:server: node --check server/server.js && node --check server/routes/upload.js && node --check server/controllers/articleController.js && node --check server/controllers/authController.js
